# test_run_length_encode.py
import pytest

from your_module import run_length_encode  # replace with the actual module name


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("s", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param("", [], id="empty-string"),
        pytest.param("a", [("a", 1)], id="single-character"),
        pytest.param("aaaa", [("a", 4)], id="all-same-character"),
        pytest.param("abc", [("a", 1), ("b", 1), ("c", 1)], id="all-unique"),
        pytest.param(
            "aabcccccaaa",
            [("a", 2), ("b", 1), ("c", 5), ("a", 3)],
            id="mixed-runs",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            "aba",
            [("a", 1), ("b", 1), ("a", 1)],
            id="same-character-non-adjacent-not-merged",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            "aaAAaa",
            [("a", 2), ("A", 2), ("a", 2)],
            id="case-sensitive",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            "  \t\t\n",
            [(" ", 2), ("\t", 2), ("\n", 1)],
            id="whitespace",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            "ééè😀😀",
            [("é", 2), ("è", 1), ("😀", 2)],
            id="unicode",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            "\0\0a",
            [("\0", 2), ("a", 1)],
            id="null-character",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_run_length_encode_returns_expected_runs(s, expected):
    assert run_length_encode(s) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad_input",
    [
        pytest.param(123, id="int"),
        pytest.param(3.14, id="float"),
        pytest.param(True, id="truthy-bool"),
        pytest.param(object(), id="plain-object"),
    ],
)
def test_run_length_encode_raises_type_error_for_truthy_non_sequence_inputs(bad_input):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        run_length_encode(bad_input)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
